ex.en: Sami has many followers on Twitter.
ex.zh: 薩米在推特上有很多追蹤者。

ex.en: The singer has over a million followers on Instagram.
ex.zh: 那位歌手在 IG 上有超過一百萬名追蹤者。

ex.en: Rousseau was mad but influential; Hume was sane but had no followers.
ex.zh: 盧梭很瘋狂，卻有影響力；休謨很理智，卻沒有追隨者。

ex.en: The religion has millions of followers.
ex.zh: 這個宗教有數百萬名信徒。

ex.en: Lignite is a fossil fuel.
ex.zh: 褐煤是一種化石燃料。

ex.en: As a result of some factories using fossil fuels, chemical emissions have already caused serious environmental problems.
ex.zh: 由於一些工廠使用化石燃料，化學物質的排放已經造成嚴重的環境問題。

ex.en: In which folder did you save the file?
ex.zh: 你把檔案存在哪個資料夾裡？

ex.en: I've got hundreds of music folders on my PC.
ex.zh: 我的電腦裡有好幾百個音樂資料夾。

ex.en: Please save the report in the shared folder.
ex.zh: 請把報告存在共用資料夾裡。

ex.en: I have lost one of my folders.
ex.zh: 我弄丟了一個文件夾。

ex.en: Where is my folder?
ex.zh: 我的文件夾去哪了？

ex.en: Let's meet by the fountain in the park.
ex.zh: 我們在公園的噴泉旁碰面吧。

ex.en: Children were playing in the fountain.
ex.zh: 小孩在噴泉裡玩水。

ex.en: He wrote the letter with a fountain pen.
ex.zh: 他是用鋼筆寫這封信的。

ex.en: How much does this fountain pen cost?
ex.zh: 這支鋼筆多少錢？

ex.en: I have lost my new fountain pen.
ex.zh: 我把新鋼筆弄丟了。

ex.en: The foreman checked the work on the construction site.
ex.zh: 工頭在工地檢查施工情形。

ex.en: Ask the foreman if you have any questions.
ex.zh: 有任何問題就問領班。

ex.en: I do not have an account in these forums.
ex.zh: 我在這些論壇上沒有帳號。

ex.en: I posted my question on an online forum.
ex.zh: 我把問題貼在網路論壇上。

ex.en: The economic forum will be held in Taipei next month.
ex.zh: 經濟論壇下個月將在台北舉行。

ex.en: The city held a public forum on the new park.
ex.zh: 市政府針對新公園舉辦了公聽會。

ex.en: She is not the founder, she's the investor.
ex.zh: 她不是創辦人，她是投資人。

ex.en: In the center of the university campus stands the statue of the founder.
ex.zh: 大學校園中央立著創校者的雕像。

ex.en: The company's founder still works there every day.
ex.zh: 公司創辦人至今仍每天到公司上班。

ex.en: Fortunately, no passengers were injured.
ex.zh: 幸好沒有乘客受傷。

ex.en: Fortunately, Dan was on the way.
ex.zh: 幸好丹已經在路上了。

ex.en: Fortunately, the meeting was postponed.
ex.zh: 幸好會議延期了。

ex.en: The thick fog made it hard to see the road.
ex.zh: 濃霧讓人很難看清路面。

ex.en: The fog began to disappear around ten o'clock.
ex.zh: 霧在十點左右開始散去。

ex.en: As the sun rose, the fog disappeared.
ex.zh: 太陽升起後，霧就散了。

fog.zh: （使）起霧、蒙上霧氣（常用 fog up）

ex.en: My glasses fogged up when I walked inside.
ex.zh: 我一走進室內，眼鏡就起霧了。

ex.en: The bathroom mirror fogs up after a hot shower.
ex.zh: 洗完熱水澡後，浴室的鏡子會起霧。

ex.en: French is the only foreign language I've ever formally studied.
ex.zh: 法語是我唯一正式學過的外語。

ex.en: The new CEO will be formally introduced on Monday.
ex.zh: 新任執行長將在週一正式與大家見面。

ex.en: Please dress formally for the dinner.
ex.zh: 晚宴請穿著正式服裝。

ex.en: Students are forbidden to smoke on the school grounds.
ex.zh: 學生不准在校園內抽菸。

ex.en: It is forbidden to cross the white line.
ex.zh: 禁止越過白線。

ex.en: The company forbids employees from sharing passwords.
ex.zh: 公司禁止員工分享密碼。

ex.en: We use chopsticks in place of knives and forks.
ex.zh: 我們用筷子，不用刀叉。

ex.en: Give us two knives and four forks, please.
ex.zh: 請給我們兩把刀和四支叉子。

ex.en: We've come to a fork in the road.
ex.zh: 我們來到了岔路口。

ex.en: Turn left at the fork in the road.
ex.zh: 在岔路口左轉。

fork.zh: fork out：（不情願地）掏錢、花大錢

ex.en: We had to fork out 500 dollars for repairs.
ex.zh: 我們不得不掏出 500 元修理費。

ex.en: I don't want to fork out that much for a phone.
ex.zh: 我不想花那麼多錢買手機。

ex.en: The program aims to foster creativity in children.
ex.zh: 這個計畫旨在培養孩子的創造力。

ex.en: We want to foster a culture of teamwork.
ex.zh: 我們希望培養團隊合作的文化。

ex.en: They have been foster parents for ten years.
ex.zh: 他們當寄養父母已經十年了。

ex.en: The child was placed in a foster home.
ex.zh: 那個孩子被安置在寄養家庭。

ex.en: The store sells clothing and footwear.
ex.zh: 這家店賣服飾和鞋類。

ex.en: Wear comfortable footwear for the hike.
ex.zh: 健行要穿舒適的鞋子。

ex.en: The greater part of the guests were foreigners.
ex.zh: 大部分的客人都是外國人。

ex.en: His accent suggests he is a foreigner.
ex.zh: 從他的口音聽得出他是外國人。

ex.en: This rule is applied to foreigners only.
ex.zh: 這條規定只適用於外國人。

ex.en: Formerly this building was a hospital.
ex.zh: 這棟大樓以前是醫院。

ex.en: The café was formerly a bookstore.
ex.zh: 這間咖啡廳以前是書店。

ex.en: Amy formerly worked for a bank in Taipei.
ex.zh: Amy 以前在台北的一家銀行上班。

ex.en: This is a forged banknote.
ex.zh: 這是一張偽鈔。

ex.en: He was caught forging his boss's signature.
ex.zh: 他被抓到偽造老闆的簽名。

ex.en: We hope to forge a strong partnership with them.
ex.zh: 我們希望和他們建立穩固的合作關係。

ex.en: The two companies forged a new alliance.
ex.zh: 這兩家公司結成了新的聯盟。

ex.en: We need to formulate a new marketing strategy.
ex.zh: 我們需要制訂新的行銷策略。

ex.en: The city formulated a plan to reduce traffic.
ex.zh: 市政府擬定了一項減少車流的計畫。

ex.en: He took a moment to formulate his answer.
ex.zh: 他花了一點時間組織他的回答。

ex.en: She found it hard to formulate her thoughts in English.
ex.zh: 她覺得很難用英文清楚表達自己的想法。

ex.en: Details will be announced at the forthcoming meeting.
ex.zh: 細節將在即將召開的會議上公布。

ex.en: We look forward to your forthcoming book.
ex.zh: 我們很期待您即將出版的新書。

forthcoming.zh: （資訊、協助）主動提供的；坦白的

ex.en: He wasn't very forthcoming about his plans.
ex.zh: 他對自己的計畫不太願意多說。

ex.en: No explanation was forthcoming from the company.
ex.zh: 公司一直沒有給出任何解釋。

ex.en: I'm afraid this is an incorrect formulation of the question.
ex.zh: 恐怕這個問題的提法不正確。

ex.en: The formulation of the new policy took months.
ex.zh: 新政策的制定花了好幾個月。

ex.en: The company changed the formulation of its shampoo.
ex.zh: 這家公司改變了洗髮精的配方。

ex.en: This new formulation is gentler on the skin.
ex.zh: 這個新配方對皮膚更溫和。

ex.en: The weather forecaster predicted heavy rain tomorrow.
ex.zh: 氣象預報員預測明天會下大雨。

ex.en: Economic forecasters expect growth to slow next year.
ex.zh: 經濟預測專家預期明年成長會趨緩。

ex.en: The dog followed its master, wagging its tail.
ex.zh: 狗搖著尾巴跟著主人。

ex.en: Please follow me.
ex.zh: 請跟我來。

ex.en: All you have to do is follow his advice.
ex.zh: 你只要照他的建議做就好。

ex.en: It was sensible of you to follow her advice.
ex.zh: 你聽她的建議是明智的。

ex.en: The following is a summary of the President's speech.
ex.zh: 以下是總統演講的摘要。

ex.en: Not until the following morning did we see land.
ex.zh: 直到第二天早上，我們才看到陸地。

ex.en: Round-trip fares to each destination are as follows.
ex.zh: 前往各目的地的來回票價如下。

ex.en: The schedule is as follows.
ex.zh: 行程如下。

ex.en: Sorry, I don't follow you.
ex.zh: 抱歉，我聽不懂你的意思。

ex.en: Did you follow the explanation?
ex.zh: 你聽懂剛才的說明了嗎？

ex.en: I was forced to go to work on Sunday.
ex.zh: 我被迫星期天去上班。

ex.en: No one is forcing you to do this.
ex.zh: 沒有人逼你做這件事。

ex.en: I will never force you to marry him.
ex.zh: 我絕不會逼你嫁給他。

ex.en: What can be done? These are market forces.
ex.zh: 能怎麼辦？這些都是市場力量。

ex.en: The wind blew with great force.
ex.zh: 風颳得非常猛烈。

ex.en: The new law is now in force.
ex.zh: 新法現在已經生效。

ex.en: These rules remain in force.
ex.zh: 這些規定仍然有效。

ex.en: The lions fought with each other to get food.
ex.zh: 獅子為了搶食物互相打鬥。

ex.en: High calorie foods are bad for my health.
ex.zh: 高熱量的食物對我的身體不好。

ex.en: Some foods make you thirsty.
ex.zh: 有些食物會讓你口渴。

ex.en: Do you like to cook Japanese foods?
ex.zh: 你喜歡煮日本料理嗎？

ex.en: Do you like spicy food?
ex.zh: 你喜歡吃辣嗎？

ex.en: He focused on his studies.
ex.zh: 他專心於學業。

ex.en: I can't focus on two things at the same time.
ex.zh: 我沒辦法同時專心做兩件事。

ex.en: The discussion focused on unemployment.
ex.zh: 討論的重點在失業問題。

ex.en: The main focus of the meeting is the new budget.
ex.zh: 會議的重點是新預算。

ex.en: Customer service is our top focus this year.
ex.zh: 客戶服務是我們今年的首要重點。

ex.en: He was covered with mud from head to foot.
ex.zh: 他從頭到腳都是泥巴。

ex.en: There's a pencil on the floor near your feet.
ex.zh: 你腳邊的地上有一支鉛筆。

ex.en: Her feet were tired after a long day at work.
ex.zh: 工作了一整天，她的腳很累。

ex.en: Do you go to school on foot every day?
ex.zh: 你每天走路上學嗎？

ex.en: The hotel is five minutes from here on foot.
ex.zh: 飯店從這裡走路五分鐘。

ex.en: The room is about 12 feet wide.
ex.zh: 這個房間大約十二英尺寬。

ex.en: He is six feet tall.
ex.zh: 他身高六英尺。

ex.en: Her house is at the foot of a mountain.
ex.zh: 她家在山腳下。

ex.en: Please sign at the foot of the page.
ex.zh: 請在頁面底部簽名。

ex.en: When I met my former teacher, he inquired after my parents.
ex.zh: 我遇到以前的老師時，他問候了我的父母。

ex.en: Kyoto is the former capital of Japan.
ex.zh: 京都是日本的舊都。

ex.en: Everyone is anxious to know what has become of the former champion.
ex.zh: 大家都很想知道前冠軍後來怎麼樣了。

ex.en: Either one is fine, but the former is more concise.
ex.zh: 兩個都可以，但前者比較簡潔。

ex.en: Of the two options, I prefer the former.
ex.zh: 兩個選項中，我比較喜歡前者。

ex.en: Don't forget to take your umbrella when you leave.
ex.zh: 你出門時別忘了帶傘。

ex.en: I meant to call her, but I forgot to.
ex.zh: 我本來要打電話給她，結果忘了。

ex.en: Tom never forgets to give his wife flowers on their wedding anniversary.
ex.zh: 湯姆從沒忘記在結婚紀念日送花給太太。

ex.en: He hurt his foot, he can't play football anymore.
ex.zh: 他腳受傷了，不能再踢足球。

ex.en: A football team consists of eleven players.
ex.zh: 一支足球隊有十一名球員。

ex.en: The football game is now on the air.
ex.zh: 足球賽正在播出。

ex.en: The forests in Taiwan stay green all year round.
ex.zh: 台灣的森林終年常綠。

ex.en: The boy lost his way in the forest.
ex.zh: 小男孩在森林裡迷路了。

ex.en: Water, forests, and minerals are important natural resources.
ex.zh: 水、森林和礦物都是重要的天然資源。

ex.en: We have to sing at an old folks home today.
ex.zh: 我們今天得去養老院唱歌。

ex.en: Some folks prefer to work from home.
ex.zh: 有些人比較喜歡在家工作。

ex.en: I'm going to visit my folks this weekend.
ex.zh: 我這個週末要回去看爸媽。

ex.en: How are your folks doing?
ex.zh: 你爸媽最近好嗎？

ex.en: We listened to traditional folk music.
ex.zh: 我們聽了傳統民謠。

ex.en: The story is based on an old folk tale.
ex.zh: 這個故事改編自一則古老的民間故事。

ex.en: You don't need to prepare a formal speech.
ex.zh: 你不需要準備正式的演講。

ex.en: How formal is this ceremony?
ex.zh: 這個典禮有多正式？

ex.en: You don't have to be so formal.
ex.zh: 你不必那麼拘謹。

ex.en: He had little formal education.
ex.zh: 他沒受過什麼正規教育。

ex.en: You don't need formal training for this job.
ex.zh: 這份工作不需要受過正規訓練。

ex.en: He walked back and forth in front of the door, hesitating to enter.
ex.zh: 他在門口走來走去，猶豫要不要進去。

ex.en: He walked back and forth on the platform while waiting for the train.
ex.zh: 他一邊等火車，一邊在月台上走來走去。

ex.en: Sami and Layla kept texting back and forth.
ex.zh: 薩米和萊拉不停地互傳簡訊。

ex.en: He asked me my age, my name, my address, and so forth.
ex.zh: 他問了我的年齡、名字、地址等等。

ex.en: We need pens, paper, folders, and so forth.
ex.zh: 我們需要筆、紙、資料夾等等。

forth.zh: 向前、向外（如 put forth、set forth 提出）

ex.en: The report sets forth several new ideas.
ex.zh: 這份報告提出了幾個新想法。

ex.en: She put forth a proposal at the meeting.
ex.zh: 她在會議上提出了一項提案。

ex.en: The chemical formula for water is H-O-H.
ex.zh: 水的化學式是 H-O-H。

ex.en: Use this formula to calculate the total cost.
ex.zh: 用這個公式計算總成本。

ex.en: There is no magic formula for success.
ex.zh: 成功沒有神奇的祕訣。

ex.en: The company found a winning formula.
ex.zh: 這家公司找到了成功的模式。

ex.en: Mathematics are the foundation of all sciences.
ex.zh: 數學是所有科學的基礎。

ex.en: Food, clothing and shelter are the foundations of survival.
ex.zh: 衣食住是生存的基礎。

ex.en: The rumor was without foundation.
ex.zh: 這個謠言毫無根據。

ex.en: The claims in the report have no foundation.
ex.zh: 報告中的說法沒有根據。

ex.en: The foundation provides scholarships for poor students.
ex.zh: 這個基金會為清寒學生提供獎學金。

ex.en: She works for a charitable foundation.
ex.zh: 她在一個慈善基金會工作。

ex.en: Fundamentally, the formation of the twelve zodiac signs is related to animal worship.
ex.zh: 從根本上說，十二生肖的形成與動物崇拜有關。

ex.en: The formation of the new team took several months.
ex.zh: 新團隊的組成花了好幾個月。

ex.en: There are several kinds of cloud formations.
ex.zh: 雲的形態有好幾種。

ex.en: The planes flew in formation over the city.
ex.zh: 飛機以編隊飛越城市上空。

ex.en: Please send the file in PDF format.
ex.zh: 請用 PDF 格式傳送檔案。

ex.en: The meeting will follow a new format.
ex.zh: 會議將採用新的形式進行。

ex.en: I've formatted your hard disk by mistake.
ex.zh: 我不小心格式化了你的硬碟。

ex.en: Please format the report before you send it.
ex.zh: 寄出報告前請先排好版。

ex.en: He will forever live on in our memories.
ex.zh: 他將永遠活在我們的記憶中。

ex.en: It's not possible for humans to live forever.
ex.zh: 人類不可能長生不老。

ex.en: I'll remember this day forever.
ex.zh: 我會永遠記得這一天。

ex.en: It would take forever for me to explain everything.
ex.zh: 要我把一切都解釋清楚，得花上好久好久。

ex.en: It took forever to get through security.
ex.zh: 通過安檢花了超久的時間。

ex.en: He lost a fortune in the stock market.
ex.zh: 他在股市賠了一大筆錢。

ex.en: He amassed a large fortune before he died.
ex.zh: 他過世前累積了龐大的財富。

ex.en: He has made a fortune through hard work.
ex.zh: 他靠努力工作賺了大錢。

ex.en: I had the good fortune to be chosen.
ex.zh: 我很幸運能被選上。

ex.en: We had the good fortune to meet a helpful local guide.
ex.zh: 我們很幸運遇到一位熱心的當地導遊。

ex.en: Tom folded the paper before handing it to Mary.
ex.zh: 湯姆先把紙摺起來才交給瑪麗。

ex.en: If you don't fold your clothes or hang them, they will be wrinkled.
ex.zh: 衣服如果不摺好或掛起來，就會皺掉。

ex.en: Please fold the towels and put them away.
ex.zh: 請把毛巾摺好收起來。

ex.en: He folded his arms and waited.
ex.zh: 他雙臂交叉等著。

ex.en: She stood with her arms folded.
ex.zh: 她雙臂交叉站著。

ex.en: The restaurant folded after only six months.
ex.zh: 那家餐廳開了半年就倒了。

ex.en: Many small businesses folded during the recession.
ex.zh: 很多小企業在不景氣時倒閉了。

ex.en: That's nonsense. Nobody but a fool would believe it.
ex.zh: 那是胡說八道，只有傻瓜才會相信。

ex.en: I felt like a fool for believing him.
ex.zh: 我竟然相信他，覺得自己像個傻瓜。

ex.en: I was angry that I had been fooled.
ex.zh: 我很氣自己被騙了。

ex.en: Don't let his smile fool you.
ex.zh: 別被他的笑容騙了。

ex.en: Stop fooling around.
ex.zh: 別再胡鬧了。

ex.en: The kids were fooling around in the classroom.
ex.zh: 孩子們在教室裡胡鬧。

fool.zh: make a fool of：讓…出醜、耍弄

ex.en: Are you trying to make a fool of me?
ex.zh: 你是想耍我嗎？

ex.en: I made a fool of myself at the party.
ex.zh: 我在派對上出糗了。

ex.en: You are very fortunate that you have such friends.
ex.zh: 你們很幸運有這樣的朋友。

ex.en: They consider themselves fortunate.
ex.zh: 他們覺得自己很幸運。

ex.en: I am fortunate compared with him.
ex.zh: 跟他比起來，我算是很幸運的。

ex.en: The university was founded by his father twenty years ago.
ex.zh: 這所大學是他父親二十年前創辦的。

ex.en: He founded the school five years ago.
ex.zh: 他五年前創辦了這所學校。

ex.en: He was still in his teens when he founded a company.
ex.zh: 他十幾歲就創立了一家公司。

found.zh: find 的過去式／過去分詞：找到、發現

ex.en: I found a bird whose wing was severely damaged.
ex.zh: 我發現了一隻翅膀嚴重受傷的鳥。

ex.en: When I opened the door, I found him asleep.
ex.zh: 我開門時，發現他睡著了。

ex.en: It was lucky for you that you found it.
ex.zh: 你能找到它真是幸運。

ex.en: See the footnote at the bottom of the page.
ex.zh: 請看頁面下方的註腳。

ex.en: Add a footnote to explain the source of the data.
ex.zh: 加一個註腳說明資料來源。

ex.en: The incident became a mere footnote in history.
ex.zh: 這起事件在歷史上只是個小插曲。

ex.en: His comment was only a footnote to the main discussion.
ex.zh: 他的意見只是主要討論的附帶一提。

ex.en: What I have in my hand is a fossil seashell.
ex.zh: 我手上拿的是一個貝殼化石。

ex.en: They found dinosaur fossils in the desert.
ex.zh: 他們在沙漠中發現了恐龍化石。

ex.en: Lignite is a fossil fuel.
ex.zh: 褐煤是一種化石燃料。

ex.en: We need to reduce our use of fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 我們需要減少使用化石燃料。

ex.en: Her smile indicates that she has forgiven me.
ex.zh: 她臉上的笑容，代表她已經原諒我了。

ex.en: She forgave the boy for his rudeness.
ex.zh: 她原諒了男孩的粗魯。

ex.en: If he told me the truth, I would have forgiven him.
ex.zh: 如果他跟我說實話，我早就原諒他了。

ex.en: It was so foggy I couldn't tell who it was.
ex.zh: 霧太大了，我看不清楚是誰。

ex.en: It's foggy here in Boston.
ex.zh: 波士頓這裡霧很大。

ex.en: She slowly disappeared into the foggy forest.
ex.zh: 她緩緩消失在霧氣瀰漫的森林中。

ex.en: My memory of that night is a bit foggy.
ex.zh: 我對那晚的記憶有點模糊。

ex.en: I feel foggy in the morning before coffee.
ex.zh: 早上沒喝咖啡前我腦袋都昏昏沉沉的。

ex.en: The weather forecast says it will be fine tomorrow.
ex.zh: 氣象預報說明天會是好天氣。

ex.en: According to the weather forecast, tomorrow will be snowy.
ex.zh: 天氣預報說明天會下雪。

ex.en: I heard the weather forecast said it'll rain tonight.
ex.zh: 我聽天氣預報說今晚會下雨。

ex.en: The news forecasts fine weather, but it seems like it is going to rain.
ex.zh: 新聞預報是好天氣，但看起來好像要下雨了。

ex.en: Experts forecast slower economic growth next year.
ex.zh: 專家預測明年經濟成長會放緩。

ex.en: In Taiwanese folklore, the Moon Lady lives on the moon.
ex.zh: 在台灣民間傳說中，嫦娥住在月亮上。

ex.en: She studies the folklore of Indigenous peoples.
ex.zh: 她研究原住民的民間傳說。

ex.en: It is not easy to learn a foreign language.
ex.zh: 學外語不容易。

ex.en: Mastering a foreign language involves a lot of patience.
ex.zh: 要精通一門外語需要很大的耐心。

ex.en: You must go to a foreign country for yourself.
ex.zh: 你一定要親自去國外看看。

ex.en: The idea of saving money was foreign to him.
ex.zh: 存錢這個觀念對他來說很陌生。

ex.en: Remove any foreign objects from the wound.
ex.zh: 清除傷口裡的異物。

ex.en: Can you tell me how to fill in this form?
ex.zh: 你能告訴我這份表格怎麼填嗎？

ex.en: Please fill out this form and sign at the bottom.
ex.zh: 請填寫這份表格並在下方簽名。

ex.en: Water and ice are the same substance in different forms.
ex.zh: 水和冰雖然形態不同，但其實是同一種物質。

ex.en: The grammatical form employed here is the present progressive.
ex.zh: 這裡用的文法形式是現在進行式。

ex.en: A long queue had formed in front of the shop.
ex.zh: 店門前排起了長長的人龍。

ex.en: He formed a habit of staying up late.
ex.zh: 他養成了熬夜的習慣。

ex.en: I sent a follow-up after the client meeting.
ex.zh: 我在客戶會議後寄出了後續郵件。

ex.en: The follow-up confirmed the revised delivery date.
ex.zh: 後續通知確認了修訂後的交貨日期。

ex.en: The retailer gained a foothold in the regional market.
ex.zh: 這家零售商在區域市場站穩了腳步。

ex.en: A local partnership gave us a foothold overseas.
ex.zh: 當地合作夥伴讓我們在海外建立了據點。

ex.en: The bank offers foreign exchange services at the airport.
ex.zh: 這家銀行在機場提供外幣兌換服務。

ex.en: Foreign exchange rates changed during the afternoon.
ex.zh: 下午外匯匯率出現變動。

ex.en: The forklift moved the pallets into the warehouse.
ex.zh: 堆高機將棧板移進倉庫。

ex.en: Only trained staff may operate the forklift.
ex.zh: 只有受過訓練的員工才能操作堆高機。

ex.en: The homeowners faced foreclosure after missing several payments.
ex.zh: 屋主多次未繳款後，面臨房屋遭法拍。

ex.en: A housing counselor helped the family avoid foreclosure.
ex.zh: 住宅諮詢員協助這個家庭避免房屋遭法拍。

ex.en: I'll follow up with the client next week.
ex.zh: 我下週會再跟客戶聯絡追蹤。

ex.en: Please follow up on the issues we discussed today.
ex.zh: 請針對今天討論的問題後續追蹤。

ex.en: Could you forward me the email from the client?
ex.zh: 可以把客戶寄來的那封信轉寄給我嗎？

ex.en: I forwarded your message to the sales team.
ex.zh: 我已經把你的訊息轉給業務團隊了。

ex.en: They are going forwards and I am always going backwards.
ex.zh: 他們一直往前走，而我總是在往後退。

ex.en: She stepped forward to ask a question.
ex.zh: 她往前走一步提出問題。

ex.en: I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.
ex.zh: 我期待很快就能收到你的信。

ex.en: I look forward to seeing you again very soon.
ex.zh: 希望早日再見到你。

ex.en: I am looking forward to seeing you next Sunday.
ex.zh: 我期待下週日能見到你。
